nodes.title: Scene 18 - The father runs - 16 segments / 130.458 seconds

properties.global_prompt:
Photorealistic live-action first-century biblical drama. Complete Scene 18, The father runs: recognition, one run, first embrace, kneeling, weeping, confession, command to Mattan, supported return to the house. Eight story beats across sixteen consecutive segments, 130.458 seconds at 24 fps. Each segment is one continuous take; cuts only at segment boundaries. Match every supplied first-frame image for exact faces, wardrobe, light and location. Younger stays wasted, dusty, worn tunic, bare feet, repaired waterskin; bundle stays the same prop. Dust that transfers onto the father stays on him. Real-time movement, restrained performance. Speak only the assigned lines once, English, lips synced. No narration, subtitles or invented dialogue. No second sprint. After the run segment the father never runs again and the camera never locks behind him on the empty road.
non_diegetic_music: Intimate live score only — solo cello, low string quartet, one distant quiet horn. No choir, piano, flute, oud, percussion, brass hits, synth or pop.
